tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Text on it: on-surface (16.5:1) or on-surface-variant (6.2:1).

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: Cards, search field and dropdown fill, navigation bar and rail background. Flat fill instead of shadows.

tokens.name: surface-container-high
tokens.usage: Selected chip fill, navigation indicator pill, language-matrix header row, curated badge, disabled button fill.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Dividers, card and table hairlines, menu and frame borders, placeholder boxes. Decorative only: 1.9:1 on surface, so never the border of an interactive control (use control-border).

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Border of interactive controls: unselected filter chips and outlined buttons. 6.2:1 on surface, meeting the 3:1 WCAG target for control boundaries.

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, sources, review dates, unselected nav labels, English meaning on phrase cards. 6.2:1 on surface, 5.6:1 on surface-container, 4.9:1 on surface-container-high.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons. 16.5:1 on surface.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Placeholder accent, the only hue: focus ring, selected state (nav indicator icon, selected-chip check), filled primary button. 5.1:1 against white. Replaced later by the brand color_scheme_seed.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label text on the filled accent button.

tokens.name: warning-container
tokens.usage: Offline and partial-mode banners. on-surface text on it: 15.6:1.

tokens.name: error-container
tokens.usage: Error view icon plate.

families.sans: "Noto Sans", "Noto Sans JP", "Noto Sans KR", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: headline-m
styles.usage: Country name on the profile header.

styles.name: headline-s
styles.usage: Screen titles (Explore, Compare, About) and app bar titles.

styles.name: title-l
styles.sample: ありがとうございます
styles.usage: Native-script phrase text, first line of a phrase card.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Remove shoes at homes, some temples, and traditional inns.
styles.usage: Cultural note text, field input text, country name in list rows.

styles.name: body-m
styles.usage: Default body, list-row subtitles, fact values.

styles.name: romanization
styles.usage: Body M italic: the romanization line on Japanese and Korean phrase cards only.

styles.name: label-m
styles.usage: Captions, sources, review dates, fact labels, nav labels, badges.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Tightest gap: icon to label inside a nav destination.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Chip gap, icon to text in buttons, fact row padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Stack gap inside a card; card gap on phone.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card padding, page margin on phone, list-row horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Gap between screen sections; page margin on desktop.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Gap between the profile header and its sections.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Vertical breathing room around empty, loading and error states.

tokens.name: page-margin-compact
tokens.usage: Page side margin under 768px.

tokens.name: page-margin-expanded
tokens.usage: Page side margin at 768px and up.

tokens.name: card-gap-compact
tokens.usage: Gap between cards under 768px.

tokens.name: card-gap-expanded
tokens.usage: Gap between cards at 768px and up.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, dropdown, menus, badges and other small elements.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards (fact, phrase, cultural note).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, buttons and the navigation indicator (pill).

tokens.name: elevation-flat
tokens.usage: Everything is flat: cards use surface-container fill, never shadows.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target for every interactive element (icon buttons, chip close, list rows).

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Material Symbols Outlined, 24px everywhere; 18px inside chips and text buttons.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max content width on desktop, centered.

tokens.name: reading-column
tokens.usage: Centered column for Explore list and About on desktop.

tokens.name: flag-list
tokens.usage: Flag image width in list rows (4:3, so 24px tall).

tokens.name: flag-profile-compact
tokens.usage: Flag image width in the profile header under 768px (64 x 48).

tokens.name: flag-profile-expanded
tokens.usage: Flag image width in the profile header at 768px and up (80 x 60).

tokens.name: photo-compact
tokens.usage: PhotoHeader height under 768px; full-bleed, no radius.

tokens.name: photo-expanded
tokens.usage: PhotoHeader height at 768px and up; radius-md banner inside the content width.

tokens.name: map-compact
tokens.usage: MapCard map height under 768px (stretch goal).

tokens.name: map-expanded
tokens.usage: MapCard map height at 768px and up (stretch goal).

tokens.name: bp-expanded
tokens.usage: Expanded layout from here up: navigation rail, up to two columns. Matches Flet ResponsiveRow md, so col={"xs": 12, "md": 6}.

tokens.name: artboard-phone
tokens.usage: Phone artboard width (390 x 844).

tokens.name: artboard-desktop
tokens.usage: Desktop artboard width (1280 x 800).
